title: Menu Navigation and Tech Walkthrough Help
summary: This topic centers on assistance with navigating vehicle menus and understanding tech settings, with the clearest complaints pointing to inadequate walkthroughs and confusing systems while several other fragments only describe help or menu actions without clear sentiment.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe missing or better-needed walkthroughs for complicated tech and dissatisfaction around support materials for learning menu-driven features.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention someone helping navigate menus, an action not helping, or manually unlocking through menus without enough context to judge satisfaction.

limitations: The sample is small and several fragments lack enough context to determine sentiment.
One negative fragment discusses comparison to another brand's tutorial support, so the cluster mixes in external reference points rather than only direct vehicle experience.
